summary: scripts/ci-parallel-tests (the ci-script-tests and genie-freshness runner) keeps a failing test script's whole log under CI_PARALLEL_TESTS_KEEP (default ~/.cache/ci-parallel-tests, run-TIME-PID/NAME.log, the latest 10 runs) and prints its path above the last 200 lines it already printed, so a failure whose cause is further up than its last lines can still be read

replay.detail: No record, signature or storage format changes.

rules.detail: Which tests run and how a lane passes or fails are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Output gains one 'whole log: PATH' line per failed test; when the directory cannot be made, the output is as before.
